narration_line: In February 1916, more than twelve hundred German guns opened fire on a quiet French fortress town.

narration_line: They massed 1,201 guns, two thirds of them heavy, against roughly six hundred French guns.

narration_line: For about ten hours, roughly a million shells fell on a front only thirty kilometres wide.

camera_move: slow tilt up to the ringing bell tower

camera_move: slow lateral pan with the convoy

camera_move: slow push-in along the road toward the horizon

narration_line: By May, forty-two French divisions had already passed through the furnace of Verdun.

camera_move: slow pull-out revealing the length of the column

narration_line: The burden spread across the whole nation, and almost every French family felt its weight.
